name: Open Obsidian Project
description: Open a new project against an Obsidian Company Memory vault. Use when the user says 'open a new project', 'start a new Obsidian project', '/open-obsidian-project', 'set up an Obsidian project', 'scaffold a project against the vault', or any close paraphrase. Reads the vault's SCHEMA.md and CONTEXT.md, scaffolds a project folder structure (notes/, outputs/, raw/), writes a session-start stub (CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md) the AI reads on every future session for that project, optionally creates a Forge-style project brief, appends an entry to the vault log, and prints a continuation prompt for the first real session on the project. Refuses if the target project folder already exists.

directory_access.scope: the project parent folder (where the new project folder is scaffolded) AND the OCM vault folder (to read SCHEMA.md + CONTEXT.md + scaffold-version.txt and to append the vault log.md). The skill refuses if the target project folder already exists.

_parent_bundle_note: This skill is a companion to the main obsidian-company-memory install skill. The main skill scaffolds the vault; this skill scaffolds project folders against the vault and is run repeatedly across the vault's life. Companion-skill naming uses the -obsidian-project suffix to avoid collisions with generic 'open project' / 'new project setup' skills the user may already have for non-Obsidian work.

_install_paths.code: auto-installed by the main obsidian-company-memory install skill (copies companion-skills/open-obsidian-project/ to ~/.claude/skills/). Manual install: git clone the repo + cp -r the folder.
_install_paths.cowork: install standalone via this plugin.json URL paste in Cowork's plugin install field. The main skill triggers this install path during scaffold; if the multi-skill plugin manifest isn't honored, fall back to the user pasting this URL directly.
_install_paths.codex_opencode: no native skill mechanism; append SKILL.md body to ~/.codex/AGENTS.md (or equivalent) under a 'Custom skills' section, or reference from the project's session stub.

trigger_phrases: start a new project against the vault
